title: Sealed Unit Manufacturer Software | IGU & Double-Glazing Units | Coglass
description: Software for sealed unit manufacturers — take and price DGU/TGU orders by make-up (cavity, spacer, gas per line) on trade accounts, track them through production and out on delivery. Built for how units are made and sold.
h1: Take, spec and price sealed units —
lead: The unit you sell is a make-up — 4/16/4, spacer, gas, toughened or laminated leaves. Coglass captures exactly that: full DGU/TGU make-ups with the cavity and spacer per line, priced on trade accounts, tracked through production and out on delivery.
steps_h2: From unit order to loaded rack
steps_sub: Coglass runs the commercial and production side of a sealed unit business, on one system.
inc_sub: Everything from the trade order to the delivered unit.
steps: {{webshop::Trade customers order by make-up and size — at the counter, by email, or a branded webshop where they reorder on their agreed prices.::Trade customers order by make-up and size — at the counter or by email, and soon on a branded webshop where they reorder on their agreed prices.}} Quick Go builds a unit order in seconds.

Full DGU/TGU build: the glass for each leaf (clear, toughened, laminated, low-E, obscure), cavity width, spacer bar and gas — captured per line, never baked into the product, so you avoid a 12/16/20mm variant of every unit.
Per-unit and per-m² pricing with trade price-lists, quantity breaks and per-customer accounts. The right price applies automatically — no retyping rate cards.
Every unit order lands on the production board and moves from cut to ready, with barcode labels per piece. Cut and process in-house, or buy in toughened / laminated leaves as outwork.
Collection with a signature at the counter, or delivery runs planned on the board, with the route on a map for finished units — units go out on stillages, not vans full of fitters.
Deposits, proformas, VAT or GST and account invoicing, synced to Xero, with overdue invoices flagged automatically.
included: Full IGU make-ups
DGU/TGU with the glass type per leaf, cavity, spacer and gas — the whole unit spec, per line.
Cavity & spacer per line
12/16/20mm set on the order line (plus a second cavity for triples), never as a product variant — no catalogue explosion.
Save-as-product & auto-match
Build a unit once, save it to your catalogue, and it auto-matches next time it is ordered.
Trade accounts & price lists
Per-customer and per-type pricing, quantity breaks and contract windows, applied automatically.
Cut-to-size unit ordering
Size, make-up and quantity captured cleanly and priced live.

One live system
